title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-sep-2026-maya-personal-notes
content:
Context: prepping for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Goal is to reconcile Q4 priorities, identify model onboarding milestones, and surface any infra/cost risks that would affect targets. Meeting: Roadmap alignment review — 2026-09-16 10:00-11:00 PT. Attendees (expected): Raj (Product), Anika (Eng - Serving Runtime), Dylan (Applied ML), Ethan (Console + Rollouts), Priya (SRE), me (Maya - Product). Quick notes to bring: 1) High-level goals for Q4: - Launch Redwood Optimize beta for a subset of customers (batching/quant recommendations). - Ship Dedicated autoscaling policy improvements (vertical scaling + burst capacity). - Private deployment: GA for VPC control plane + basic KMS integration. - Improve latency p50 for chat workloads by ~15% via kernel selector and KV cache optimizations. 2) Model onboarding / Applied ML asks (Dylan): - Need 2 weeks of infra validation per model variant (quantized/gfloat) prior to canary. - Priority models: open-llama-13B-v2 (primary), redwood-chat-7B (fallback), embedding-bert-large. - Eval hooks: automated regression tests against baseline prompt set (linked: ML-101). 3) Eng constraints / risks (Anika): - Current Dedicated pool saturation expected mid-Oct if we keep current commit levels — may need to increase reserved capacity or enable more aggressive routing to hosted variants. - Autoscale improvements ETA: 2026-10-20 internal rollout, GA 2026-11-10. - Quantization profiles for 13B still unstable on A100; need extra perf tests on H100. 4) Product trade-offs (me): - Want to keep Optimize beta quality bar high; if model regressions too frequent, we delay beta and run more evals. - Need clarity on which customers are in beta (should align with Dedicated customers who consent to early kernels). 5) Observability / metrics: - Want token-level cost delta estimates per model variant (Ethan to surface API-level charts). - SLA impact: p99 latency to be tracked per route; target no more than +50ms variance on fallback. 6) Ops / SRE flags (Priya): - Network egress for private deployments still under audit; potential blocker for GA in EU region. - Need KMS rotation plan before on-prem GA. Agenda (15/45/60 min depending on cadence): - 10m: Quick goals recap (Maya) - 15m: Applied ML model onboarding plan + eval cadence (Dylan) - 15m: Eng constraints and infra timeline (Anika) - 10m: Product trade-offs, customer beta list (Maya + Raj) - 10m: Open risks, blocked items, next steps (All) Key decisions to propose: - Lock Optimize beta to "Dedicated customers + 3 hosted partners" for initial rollout. - Prioritize open-llama-13B-v2 onboarding sequence and allocate H100 perf runs this week. - Defer Private GA in EU until egress/KMS audit resolved; set contingency date 2026-12-15. Open questions / things to surface in sync: - Raj: confirm top 3 customer candidates for Optimize beta by EOD 2026-09-17. - Anika: confirm whether we can run additional H100 perf tests within this sprint (ETA?). - Dylan: can eval harness be extended to include latency-sensitive prompt sets to catch regressions earlier? - Priya: any additional compliance docs required for KMS escrow? Quick talking points (short, use in meeting): - "We need to balance shipping Optimize beta vs. avoiding noisy regressions — propose canary with 2-week eval guardrails." - "If Dedicated capacity hits 85% by mid-Oct we trigger two actions: increase reserved capacity OR enable hosted fallbacks for non-critical routes." - "Private GA in EU contingent on egress audit; propose customer communications plan if delayed." Action items (draft) - assign owners and dates below. Personal notes / TODOs before meeting: - Pull recent Dedicated capacity utilization report (Ethan / infra dashboard) and attach to deck. - Add a slide with model onboarding pipeline and gates (Dylan to provide checklist). - Draft communication for customers if Private GA slips (Raj + Customer Success). - Add canary evaluation rubric to Optimize spec (me + Dylan). - Check on H100 availability in staging (Anika + infra). Tone/ask for meeting: come with clear asks (yes/no decisions) and concrete dates. Keep the sync tight: if we can't reach decision on GA dates, we should create follow-up task with required blockers listed. 

Notes from previous sync (2026-08-30): - Agreed on model prioritization but not on H100 perf timeline; Anika to follow up. - Raj to draft initial customer beta list (not finalized). - Ethan started work on token-level cost dashboards (WIP).

Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Model regressions in Optimize beta -> Mitigation: stricter eval gates + phased rollout. - Risk: Dedicated pool saturation -> Mitigation: autoscaling + hosted fallbacks + customer communication. - Risk: EU egress compliance for Private -> Mitigation: escalate with security/compliance, temporary region hold.

Meeting prep checklist (items I will do before 9/16): - [ ] Attach Dedicated utilization chart (Ethan link) - [ ] Finalize 1-slide goals summary - [ ] Confirm beta customer list with Raj - [ ] Upload eval rubric draft to ML-101 page - [ ] Ping Anika about H100 perf window

Follow-ups after meeting (placeholder for writing up decisions + owners)
